title: Arbitration 1.0.0
description: A dispute's only exit, and only a human hand writes it. `arbitrate` is refused whenever an identity handoff exists for the call, which is the case for every agent tool call a hook saw.

dispute.description: The identifier of the dispute being arbitrated.

decision.description: `uphold` closes the finding by arbitration and allows one fresh review on the same state; `reject` puts its remedy or correction back to pending.
